errors.evidence: The description states the solid line grows to about 23,000 in 2021, but the figure shows the value at the start of 2021 is significantly higher, at approximately 24,500.

The description claims the dotted series passes through approximately 20,000 around 2019-2020. While some points in 2019 are near 20,000, the points in 2020 are substantially higher, ranging from about 21,500 to 22,500. This makes the statement misleading for the 2020 period.
